name: Alaska Airlines (and Hawaiian Airlines)
max_carrier_dimensions: Soft-sided carrier max 17 x 11 x 9.5 in (per Alaska's official newsroom, Aug 26, 2026)
max_combined_weight: Baggage compartment: up to 150 lb pet + kennel combined (official newsroom, Aug 26, 2026)

fees.amount: $100 per carrier each way ($35 wholly within Hawaii)
$200 per kennel each way (discounts within Alaska/Hawaii and for active-duty military)

checked_or_cargo: Yes: temperature-controlled baggage compartment on your flight, or Pet Connect via Alaska Air Cargo for unaccompanied pets.
banned_breeds: Brachycephalic (short-nosed) dogs are not permitted in the baggage compartment (official newsroom).
service_animal_note: Trained service animals travel free; see Alaska's accessible travel services section.
notes: The detailed 'Pets in cabin' page renders client-side and could not be read by our fetcher; carrier size and fees come from Alaska's overview page (fees range $100-$200) and its official newsroom post of Aug 26, 2026. An older search snippet of Alaska's fee page showed $150 for the baggage compartment: a contradiction to check with the airline.
